snippet.title: FateZ: Zombie Survival – Official Gameplay Trailer (Android & iOS)
snippet.description:
FateZ: Unturned Zombie Survival is an open-world zombie survival game with a unique low poly style. Dive into a post-apocalyptic adventure where your goal is simple: survive. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons and tools, and build your own base to protect what you’ve earned.

How long can you stay alive?

Download for Android 🤖
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DastroGamesStudio.FateZ

Download for iOS 🍎
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fatez-zombie-survival/id6749870503?uo=2&partnerId=11&at=1001l5Uo

🔥GAME FEATURES!
✓ Massive open world to explore
✓ Crafting system for weapons, tools, and gear
✓ Base building and defense mechanics
✓ Dynamic day-night cycle with weather effects
✓ Survival systems: hunger, thirst, diseases
✓ Breakable melee weapons and firearms with a repair system 
✓ Farming, planting and fishing
✓ Multiplayer
✓ Vehicles with fuel system and flat tire replacement 
✓ Safe zone, trading, and missions
✓ Customizable character
✓ Swimming and Diving
✓ Enemy Bandits
✓ Zombie hordes!
✓ Parkour Climbing
✓ Levels and skills
✓ Gamepad support
✓ Languages :  Arabic, Dutch, English, French, Turkish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Spanish (Mexico), Korean, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai, German, Japanese, Italian, Chinese, Hindi, Indonesian, Vientamese,

👉 More info at https://srbunker.com/fatez
